Budget offers little new relief for middle-income Canadians struggling with costs, CityNews Ottawa reports.
Trump names Stephen Miller White House chief of staff after Susie Wiles resigns, The Associated Press reports.
Tesla’s Cybertruck, the hulking, stainless-steel pickup that inspired devotion and derision with its science-fiction looks, will cease production next year, The Associated Press reports.
Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy is discharged from hospital after a stroke and goes to rehab facility, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
